product_one_liner.value: Fly.io is a global cloud platform for developers and AI agents to deploy and run applications and databases close to users.
product_one_liner.notes: The company description says developers deploy apps to Fly.io in regions close to users; the company’s current announcement describes connected infrastructure and computers for AI agents. Together these establish the product and its users.
